I was born and raised in a small town in the Midwest. My parents were hardworking individuals who instilled in me the values of perseverance and determination. I have an older sister who has been my role model and confidant throughout my life. Despite our differences, we have always been close, and she has played a significant role in shaping who I am today.

Growing up, I was an introverted child who preferred spending time alone, lost in my thoughts and daydreams. I had a few close friends, but I never felt the need to be the center of attention. Instead, I found solace in books, art, and music. These passions allowed me to escape to far-off lands and explore new ideas without leaving the comfort of my home.

As I grew older, I became increasingly interested in learning about the world around me. This curiosity led me to pursue a degree in psychology, where I studied human behavior, emotion, and cognition. During my studies, I discovered a passion for helping others, which eventually prompted me to seek a career in counseling. Today, I work as a licensed therapist, assisting clients in navigating the challenges and complexities of life.

Outside of my professional life, I enjoy engaging in various hobbies and pastimes. I am an avid photographer and love capturing moments of beauty and wonder through my lens. I also enjoy cooking, experimenting with new recipes and flavors to create delicious meals for myself and my loved ones. My love for the arts extends to film and theater, and I frequently attend local productions and film festivals.

Traveling is another great passion of mine. Whether it's exploring a bustling city or trekking through the wilderness, I find joy in immersing myself in new cultures and environments. These experiences have broadened my perspective and enriched my understanding of the world and its inhabitants.

Throughout my life, I have learned to embrace my unique qualities and embrace my individuality. While I may not fit the mold of what society deems "normal," I have come to recognize that it is my differences that make me special and valuable. By staying true to myself and continuing to learn and grow, I hope to inspire others to do the same and live a fulfilling and authentic life.
